family.description: Steroid receptor-associated and regulated protein is also known as ER-related factor, ERRF, or C1orf64. It is thought to regulate the transcriptional function of androgen and oestrogen receptors [[cite:PUB00087321]]. Proteins in this family are typically between 145 and 169 amino acids in length, and have a conserved IDC sequence motif.
family.name: Steroid receptor-associated and regulated protein
